_comment: Manual corrections applied by scripts/sign-cbom.mjs to ShorSight's raw scan before it is published and signed. Each corrected component records what was changed in a 'beyond-shor:correction' property. Fix these in ShorSight itself, then drop the entry.

crypto/aes-256-gcm.reason: AES-256 key search is the reference for NIST category 5, not 1.

set.properties.crypto:rationale: ECDSA over NIST P-256 (sign/verify in the signature playground); broken by Shor's algorithm.

crypto/ec-p256.reason: Only sign and verify are used (ECDSA), so the primitive is signature, not key-agree.

set.properties.crypto:rationale: Code-based post-quantum KEM. Since 2026-10-01 the BSI advises against new deployments: structural attacks published in 2026 put the estimated security below the claimed levels. Kept in the playground for comparison only.

crypto/classic-mceliece.reason: New structural cryptanalysis (2026) and the BSI advisory of 2026-10-01.
